purpose: Canonical cross-system company identity envelope without replacing source-owned company data.
rules: entity_id is a Nexus federation identifier, not a replacement for source IDs.
Every source-owned record keeps its original source_ref.
Conflicting facts remain attributed to their sources until resolved.
Nexus identity does not silently overwrite WCA, Report Aziende, CRM or research data.
Automatic merges require deterministic high-confidence identifiers; ambiguous matches stay separate.
